lines.zh: 我趴着往前走，肚子擦地。
lines.en: I move on my belly, scraping the ground.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拖在身后很重。
lines.en: My tail drags heavy behind me.
I climb onto a hot stone.
I walk slowly in the sun.
I loop around a rock crevice.
My claws catch the ground.

lines.zh: 我沿着石缝慢慢爬过去。
lines.en: I crawl along the rock seam toward you.
I look up once, then down.

lines.zh: 我拖着长身体钻进草里。
lines.en: I drag my long body into the grass.
I stop there to bask.
I turn and keep crawling.
I move with my belly against the sand.
I head slowly for somewhere warm.
I drag my tail across the gravel.
I move a step at a time, in no hurry.
I sprawl on the stone, warm.
I sun myself with eyes closed.
My tail taps the ground.
I am storing heat.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，让热气散出去。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open to let the heat out.
I raise my head and listen.

lines.zh: 我的舌头探出来又缩回。
lines.en: My tongue flicks out and back.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤在太阳下发亮。
lines.en: My hide shines in the sun.
In warmth I am more restless.
I slowly spread myself out.
I lie on the hot stone with my eyes half shut.

lines.zh: 我在挑一块更热的石头。
lines.en: I am picking a hotter stone.
I rest my head on a claw.
My tail tip curls.
I crack one eye open.
I raise my head to you, slowly.
My tongue flickers out.

lines.zh: 我在闻你身上有没有伤。
lines.en: I'm sniffing you for wounds.
I tilt my head, calm.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的爪前。
lines.en: Your shadow falls at my foreclaw.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的那样东西。
lines.en: I stare at that thing in your hand.
I slowly raise my front.

lines.zh: 我在判断你值不值得咬。
lines.en: I am judging whether you are worth biting.

lines.zh: 我撑起前半身，靠近一点。
lines.en: I prop up my front half and come a little closer.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向挪了一步。
lines.en: I shift one step your way.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，一直没眨眼。
lines.en: I keep my head low and never blink.
I neither call out nor run.
I open my mouth slightly.
You stand still, so I study you slowly.
I wait for you to reach in.
I watch you low to the ground, very still.
I watch you, very quiet.

lines.zh: 我抬起前爪，又轻轻放下。
lines.en: I lift a forepaw and set it down softly.
I try to come a little closer.
Having judged, I lie back down.
I roll over and curl up.
I let out a hiss.
I squeeze into the crevice, tail last.
My tail curls in.

lines.zh: 我拖着身子往石缝里退。
lines.en: I drag myself back into the rock crevice.

lines.zh: 我的毒腺一跳一跳地疼。
lines.en: My venom gland throbs with pain.
A new mark shows on my hide.
I shudder all over.
I open my mouth at you.
I stare at you without moving.
I lift my head at the smell of carrion.

lines.zh: 我慢吞吞地朝那块肉爬。
lines.en: I crawl slowly toward the meat.
I take it up in my jaws.
I bite it and slam it on the ground.
I swallow slowly and with effort.

lines.zh: 我把那块肉拖到石头后。
lines.en: I drag the meat behind the rock.
I look up at you again.
I drag it behind a stone.
I guard it from being taken.
That smell is wrong. I won't eat it.
I pin the meat down and tear it.
I eat bite after bite.
I eat until I am sluggish.
I crawl to your feet with it.
I look up for more.
I crunch it down, bones and all.
I lick the taste off my claws.
You bump me and I slide half a block.
My tail lashes your leg.
I yield softly.
Your bump rolls me onto my back.
We land one dull thud.
I slowly shift my body.
You step on the tip of my tail.
I flinch and sprawl again.
I bump you and instantly pull back.
You cannot move me at all.

lines.zh: 两条巨蜥在石头上相遇。
lines.en: Two monitor lizards meet on the stone.
We butt heads gently.
I rub its back with my chin.

lines.zh: 我们两个占住这块热石。
lines.en: The two of us claim this hot stone.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴和它的缠了一下。
lines.en: Our tails twine once.
We slip into a crevice together.
It rests its head on my back.
Neither of us moves.
We sprawl side by side.
We listen to the wind together.
I take the egg in my mouth.
I pin it beneath my claw.
I drag it two blocks.
It slips in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我刨了个坑，把它藏起来。
lines.en: I dig a pit and stash it away.
I sniff it and leave it alone.
The shell is too hard; I give up.
I push it under a stone.
I carry it in my jaws onto the warm stone.
I let go and it rolls away.
I gather my hind half under me.
My tongue flicks out.

lines.zh: 我闻到血，就在石头后面。
lines.en: I smell blood, just behind the rock.
I begin crawling your way.
I prop up my front half.
I show my venom fangs.
I've sunned on this rock for three years.

lines.zh: 我算着你下一步落哪儿。
lines.en: I'm working out where your next step lands.
I have found a heading.

lines.zh: 我把全身的力气放在后腿。
lines.en: I load all my strength into my hind legs.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的气味慢慢爬。
lines.en: I crawl slowly along your scent.
You change direction, and I change with you.
I hold this distance throughout.
I'll follow you until you stop.
My tongue keeps testing the air.
You climb a rock; so do I.
I hug the ground and circle behind you.

lines.zh: 你躲到树后，我也到树后。
lines.en: You hide behind a tree; I come too.
Every stretch I crawl, I stop.

lines.zh: 你的脚踩在碎石上，很响。
lines.en: Your feet on the gravel are loud.
My teeth hook into your leg guard.
My teeth carry venom.
My tail cracks your knee.
I lunge with my whole body.
You shake my grip off.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的肩膀不松口。
lines.en: I lock my jaws on your shoulder and hold.
My claws hold your foot.
You are dragged to one knee.
I bite your wrist from the side.
My bite is shallow and it hurts.

lines.zh: 热石头上多了一条影子。
lines.en: A shadow appears on the hot stone.
I push the rubble aside and come out.
The sand here shifts.
I begin to bask.

lines.zh: 我从晒热的石头下爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out from under a sun-warmed rock.
My tail shows first.

lines.zh: 你听见鳞片擦地的声音。
lines.en: You hear scales scraping ground.
A long shadow moves slowly.

lines.zh: 我在这块石头上摊开了。
lines.en: I sprawl on this stone.
I slide down the slope, slowly.
I begin to exist, without a sound.

lines.zh: 我的舌头探了一下空气。
lines.en: My tongue tests the air.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的皮，我缩进石头下。
lines.en: Fire touches my hide and I shrink under a rock.

lines.zh: 我从石头上滑下去，摔在沙里。
lines.en: I slide off the rock and land in the sand.

lines.zh: 水让我发冷，我动不了了。
lines.en: Water chills me and I cannot move.
The blast flips me over and my four claws scrabble.
The arrow shaft wobbles outside my hide.
That force stiffens me.
Hunger leaves me too weak to crawl.

lines.zh: 雷声让我整条贴在地上。
lines.en: The thunder flattens me to the ground.

lines.zh: 下面的地没了，我一圈圈往下掉。
lines.en: The ground is gone; I tumble down.
